figurative_meaning_bn: বিয়ের আগে পাত্র-পাত্রীকে হলুদমিশানো জলে স্নান করানোর অনুষ্ঠান
figurative_meaning_en: The pre-wedding ritual of bathing the bride and groom in turmeric-mixed water
example_sentences_in_bangla: বিয়ের আগে গায়ে হলুদের অনুষ্ঠানে সবাই উপস্থিত ছিল।
তারা গায়ে হলুদ করে বিয়ের প্রস্তুতি নিচ্ছে।
example_sentences_in_english: Everyone attended the gaye holud ceremony before the wedding.
They are preparing for the wedding by performing the gaye holud ritual.
history: This idiom refers to the traditional Bengali wedding ritual known as Gaye Holud, derived from ancient Hindu customs symbolizing purification, prosperity, and warding off evil, commonly practiced in Bengali communities across India and Bangladesh.
note: Primarily associated with Hindu Bengali weddings but observed in secular contexts as well.
